raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 5, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the dates—swapping Belleau Wood (June 1–26, 1918) with Peleliu (September 15–November 27, 1944)—and thus concluded the wrong battle occurred earlier.
